title: MOTION (HUTT - PRICE) relative to funding for expenses associated with the Pan African Film and Arts Festival in Council District Ten (CD 10).
text:
[Council File 26-1459; CD 10]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HUTT - PRICE) relative to funding for expenses associated with the Pan African Film and Arts Festival in Council District Ten (CD 10).
Recommendations for Council action:
UTILIZE $200,000 from the AB1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281210 (CD 10 Redevelopment Projects - Services) for expenses associated with the Pan African Film and Arts Festival in CD 10, currently being provided by The Pan African Film Festival under City Contract C-201736, for an extended period from July 1, 2026 to December 31, 2027.
INSTRUCT and AUTHORIZE the City Clerk to prepare, process and execute the necessary documents with and/or payments to The Pan African Film Festival, or any other agency or organization, as appropriate, utilizing the above amount, for the above purpose, subject to the approval of the City Attorney as to form.
AUTHORIZE the City Clerk to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
